captions.detailed: A medieval siege bombard featuring a short, thick, black wrought-iron barrel nested within a heavy brown timber trough cradle. The barrel is equipped with two cylindrical side trunnions that rest in corresponding U-shaped cutouts on the cradle's wooden side walls. This design allows the barrel to rotate on a revolute joint for pitch elevation adjustments, while the cradle remains stationary on the ground.
captions.instruction: Create a 3D model of a medieval siege bombard consisting of a heavy wooden trough cradle and a short, thick wrought-iron barrel. The barrel should be mounted on trunnions that fit into the side walls of the cradle to allow for rotational elevation adjustment.
captions.factory: Construct the stationary wooden cradle using box primitives to form the thick side panels, front and rear blockades, and support blocks. Create U-shaped cutouts in the side panels using boolean operations to receive the trunnions. Build the barrel by combining concentric cylinder primitives of varying diameters to form the stepped outer rings and inner bore, then add two lateral cylinders for the trunnions. Finally, define a revolute joint along the lateral axis connecting the barrel to the cradle.
